The main differences between men and women are biological, psychological, and cultural. Biologically, men tend to have more muscle mass and higher levels of testosterone, while women tend to have higher levels of estrogen. Psychologically, men tend to be more competitive and aggressive, while women tend to be more collaborative and communicative. Culturally, men and women are socialized differently, leading to different expectations and roles in society.
